retry.note: Retries only on HTTP 429 and 5xx. Short backoff so a Vercel 60s function can finish. This Vercel module calls generateContent for copy (and health isolation tests) only. Omni video generation runs on Patrick's server.

video.optionalNote: Veo 3.1 ids are on the Gemini API but are not the default. This Vercel app does not call Omni; Patrick's server owns generation. Sidecar.model must still be an allowed or optional id.

copy.copyModelNote: Pinned gemini-3.5-flash to preserve SATCOM Video Studio captions/copy behavior (verified still listed 2026-09-29). gemini-3.8-flash is the current recommended Flash and is allow-listed for an explicit upgrade; do not invent ids or use -latest aliases.

health.note: Health IQ (formerly ask_susan). Isolated key, budget and circuit. This Vercel app does not call it. Log counts and dollars only — never prompt or response text. No fallback to GEMINI_KEY_VIDEO or GEMINI_KEY_COPY.

gemini-omni-1.1-flash.note: Paid tier only. Used by Patrick's Omni queue, not by this Vercel module. 1080p is upscaled; estimate at the 720p token rate.

gemini-3.8-flash.note: Standard paid prices through 2026-12-31, then $1.50 / $7.50 per 1M tokens.

veo-3.1-generate-preview.note: Optional on Patrick's server. Not the default video path.

veo-3.1-fast-generate-preview.note: Optional on Patrick's server. Not the default video path.

billingAccount.note: Patrick's Gemini consumer / Google AI Studio subscription does not cover Gemini API charges. Set a hard cap on the Google Cloud billing account and per-project budgets. In-app daily/monthly caps are a second line of defense only and cannot stop a leaked key.

handoff.synthidNote: This video was generated by Google Gemini Omni Flash. All Google AI generated videos carry an invisible SynthID watermark for provenance. Label it as AI-generated wherever it is used.
